text_block_list.text:
On my way home, I spot Симболи Рудольф
heading
for the practice track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With things unusually quiet around the
academy,
I could think of no better way
to spend my free
time.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, but there's no need to worry. I
find the
exertion pleasantly bracing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Don't bite off more than you can chew.

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I knew you would see things my
way!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Then we shall train for as long as time
allows.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Together we'll strive for heights that
none have
ever seen!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Are you concerned I'll overexert myself?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
All Umamusume have a responsibility to
take
their trainer's words seriously.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Very well. I will consider training finished
for
today.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, the two of us end up
training until
the track closes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't do to fix my sights so high
that I fall
flat on my face.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
